Both deliverables are written and verified.

## Summary

**Deliverables**
- `~/docker-build-context-enospc.md` — full solution write-up (root cause, exact fix, pitfalls, verification).
- `~/.dockerignore.template` — ready-to-copy `.dockerignore`.

**Root cause:** Docker streams the whole build context to the daemon before the first `RUN`; with no `.dockerignore`, `.git` history, 28 MB of docs/screenshots, `web/node_modules`, local data stores and root binaries were all transferred, exhausting disk on the tight host.

**Fix:** a root `.dockerignore` pruning VCS/CI, docs, agent state, node modules, data stores, subprojects and root binaries — while keeping `web/dist` ignored but `!web/dist/.gitkeep` re-included for the `go:embed all:dist` closure. Measured 67.95 MB → 22.42 MB with the full build still exiting 0.

**What I actually verified in this environment** (Docker daemon wasn't runnable — no root, no socket, `dockerd` refuses unprivileged):
1. Ran the exact ignore rules through Docker's own `github.com/moby/patternmatcher` (`ignorefile.ReadAll` + `MatchesOrParentMatches`) and confirmed every unwanted path is ignored while `web/dist/.gitkeep` and all runtime sources stay included.
2. Reproduced the `grep -m1` trap: piping a long producer into `grep -m1` yields exit `141` (SIGPIPE), whereas full consumption yields `0` — so the doc mandates capturing the whole build log and grading `${PIPESTATUS[0]}`.

Two discoveries from the verification that made it into the doc/template: a bare `*.log` only matches the context root in the matcher (so use `data/*.log`), and excluding a `replace`-referenced module dir would break `go build`.

signatures.description: docker build dies ResourceExhausted/no space left on device on a clean/disk-tight machine because the repo ships no .dockerignore: 76.57MB context (.git history + 28MB docs/ screenshots) streams into the daemon before the first RUN. Fix that worked: add .dockerignore excluding .git/.github/docs/memory-bank/screenshots/TODO/CHANGELOG/.vfs/.coding-hermes/.gitreins/.ralph/.agents/.opencode/.openhands/tmp/memory/web/node_modules/web/dist(with !web/dist/.gitkeep for a go:embed all:dist closure)/data/*.db/*.duckdb/*.parquet/*.log/*.tmp/sdk/mcp-tools/tests/examples + stray root binaries; measured 67.95MB -> 22.42MB and the FULL image build still exited 0. Two pitfalls: (1) docker only honours .dockerignore (never .gitignore), so a working-tree artifact that is gitignored still streams unless the pattern is in .dockerignore; (2) a go:embed dir whose contents are gitignored needs a negation for its committed placeholder or the container loses embedded assets; (3) prove non-regression by running the FULL build, not just the transfer-size line - a `grep -m1` on --progress=plain output SIGPIPEs the build at an intermediate frame.
